verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Ollama has a REST API and documentation that walks through sending a curl request. Nothing in the pack shows an interactive API reference, such as a try-it console or an in-browser runnable playground. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe found no spec at any candidate path, so a static guide with copyable curl commands is only adjacent to the story, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
